task: Unified Autoregressive Framework with Decoupled Visual Encoding

core_method.name: Decoupled Visual Encoding for Unified Multimodal Transformer
core_method.description: A single autoregressive Transformer architecture that decouples visual encoding into two specialized pathways: an understanding encoder optimized for OCR/VQA/semantic tasks, and a generation encoder optimized for image reconstruction quality. Both produce discrete visual tokens consumed by a shared transformer.
key_innovations: Dual-pathway visual tokenization: separate encoders for understanding vs generation
Shared autoregressive transformer backbone for both modalities
Task-adaptive routing: understanding tokens vs generation tokens
Unified vocabulary across text and visual tokens

named_methods_referenced.llava: Visual instruction tuning with projection layer (paper_001)
named_methods_referenced.llamagen: Vanilla AR models for image generation via next-token prediction (paper_003)
